name: Q-CLASH! [WINTER EVENT]
desc:
Q-CLASH, the first-person class-based action game is free to play!

⚔️ Try out all 8 Clashers!
💎 All with their own unique weapons, abilities and personalities!
👕 Collect over 60 character skins!
🕺 Taunt your foes with emotes and dances!
🎨 Tag the map with sprays!
🎖️ Unlock achievements!
🛠️ Craft tokens and items!
⭐ Rank your Clashers up!
🚅 Watch out for the train!
🎙️With a full professional voice cast!

🏆 Winner of 2019 Gameplay Innovation Award
